description: Convert between a subnet mask, CIDR prefix, wildcard mask and device count. Input a dotted mask (255.255.255.192 -> /26), a wildcard (0.0.0.255 -> /24), a prefix (/22) or how many devices you need ("50 hosts" -> smallest prefix that fits). Returns prefix, mask, wildcard, total and usable addresses, binary mask.
name: subnet_mask_convert
